items.summary: Preprint on speculative decoding that adapts to load across a tiered key-value cache. Aims at serving efficiency when memory pressure varies.
items.whyItMatters: Relevant if you serve long-context models and tune decoding for throughput.

items.summary: Preprint proposing an information-gain criterion for deciding what supervised fine-tuning should learn, aimed at better generalization after post-training.
items.whyItMatters: Offers a lens for choosing SFT data before you spend compute on it.

items.summary: Benchmark that tests agentic models on long-horizon strategic play in the card game Slay the Spire.
items.whyItMatters: A new yardstick for planning over many steps, beyond short tool-use tasks.

items.summary: Preprint describing a multi-agent LLM setup that tunes specialized neural networks automatically.
items.whyItMatters: Shows one way to hand model-tuning chores to LLM agents.

items.summary: Preprint on on-policy self-distillation for reasoning where the teacher critiques rather than only scores, arguing scoring alone cannot guide search.
items.whyItMatters: Relevant to anyone training reasoning models with teacher feedback.

items.summary: Preprint training causal language models on chains of edits so they can decode in flexible order rather than strictly left to right.
items.whyItMatters: Points to generation that can revise text, not only append to it.

items.summary: Preprint on removing specific knowledge from large reasoning models without the collapse in ability that unlearning often causes.
items.whyItMatters: Matters if you must remove data from a deployed reasoning model.

items.summary: Preprint using counterfactual guidance in few-shot distillation to improve LLM question answering.
items.whyItMatters: A small-data route to compact QA models; check results on your domain.

items.summary: Paper on using expert selection biases in mixture-of-experts models to cope with imbalanced training data.
items.whyItMatters: Useful if your MoE training data is skewed across domains or languages.

items.summary: Preprint introducing an input-dependent readout phase for resonant sequence models, a niche alternative to standard attention.
items.whyItMatters: Architecture curiosity; no practical change yet.

items.summary: Preprint about forecasting where different corpus-sampling choices will disagree in masked text reconstruction.
items.whyItMatters: Narrow methodology work, mainly for researchers studying data sampling.

items.summary: Preprint rethinking how diffusion and decoding divide work in parallel language generation, proposing predictive-state flows.
items.whyItMatters: Part of the push toward faster non-autoregressive text generation.

items.summary: Preprint on credit alignment for distilling between models that use different tokenizers.
items.whyItMatters: Helps when the teacher and student models do not share a vocabulary.

items.summary: Test framework for evaluating how well LLMs write quantum code.
items.whyItMatters: A ready harness if you evaluate code models on quantum SDK tasks.

items.summary: Study revisiting accent classification with a distilled speech model, using speaker-disjoint splits and cross-corpus tests.
items.whyItMatters: A reminder to use speaker-disjoint splits when evaluating speech models.

items.summary: Preprint presenting a Romanian-first language model family trained end to end.
items.whyItMatters: A regional-language model option; check benchmarks before relying on it.

items.summary: Study comparing human and LLM facilitators in collaborative design meetings using behavioral measures.
items.whyItMatters: Early evidence on where LLMs fit as meeting facilitators.

items.summary: Overview paper on the essentials of causal discovery in time series.
items.whyItMatters: Useful reading if you work with temporal data and causal questions.

items.summary: Paper on variance-reduced optimization that does not need to know the smoothness constant in advance.
items.whyItMatters: Theory work with little near-term effect on practice.

items.summary: Preprint on numerical stabilization techniques for running PPO in half precision.
items.whyItMatters: Could cut memory in RL fine-tuning if it holds up on your setup.

items.summary: Preprint describing a unified training lifecycle for LLM agents that use tools.
items.whyItMatters: A possible template for training tool-using agents end to end.

items.summary: Preprint on a compact latent world-action model for robot manipulation on edge hardware.
items.whyItMatters: Shows small world models may fit on robot-grade devices.

items.summary: Theoretical analysis of how GFlowNets train.
items.whyItMatters: Background theory; little to act on yet.

items.summary: Paper on holomorphic neural networks for 2D and 3D Laplace problems.
items.whyItMatters: Niche scientific-computing method.

items.summary: Report on Microsoft CEO Satya Nadella saying teams should treat all AI models as compromised. Drew heavy discussion on Hacker News.
items.whyItMatters: Frames model security as an assumption in system design, not an afterthought.

items.summary: Hacker News discussion of a post arguing people increasingly disagree about what LLMs can do.
items.whyItMatters: Explains why teams judge model capability so differently.

items.summary: Alignment Forum post arguing alignment work should finish before the next, more capable model is trained.
items.whyItMatters: A viewpoint in the safety-pacing debate, not a policy change.
